title: Owl holding a balloon
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- balloon string -->
  <path d='M70 38 Q66 52 60 66' stroke='#7fd4ff' stroke-width='2' fill='none'/>
  <!-- balloon -->
  <ellipse cx='72' cy='24' rx='14' ry='17' fill='#ff5577'/>
  <ellipse cx='72' cy='24' rx='14' ry='17' fill='none' stroke='#ff9ab0' stroke-width='2'/>
  <ellipse cx='67' cy='18' rx='4' ry='5' fill='#ffb3c4'/>
  <polygon points='72,41 68,46 76,46' fill='#ff5577'/>
  <polygon points='72,41 68,46 76,46' fill='none' stroke='#ff9ab0' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- owl body -->
  <ellipse cx='44' cy='68' rx='24' ry='27' fill='#8b6b4a'/>
  <!-- belly -->
  <ellipse cx='44' cy='74' rx='15' ry='18' fill='#e8c9a0'/>
  <!-- belly feather marks -->
  <path d='M36 68 q4 4 8 0 M44 68 q4 4 8 0 M36 76 q4 4 8 0 M44 76 q4 4 8 0' stroke='#c9a878' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- left wing holding string -->
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='58' rx='8' ry='13' transform='rotate(30 62 58)' fill='#6e5438'/>
  <!-- right wing -->
  <ellipse cx='26' cy='62' rx='8' ry='14' transform='rotate(-20 26 62)' fill='#6e5438'/>
  <!-- ear tufts -->
  <polygon points='26,46 30,32 36,44' fill='#6e5438'/>
  <polygon points='62,46 58,32 52,44' fill='#6e5438'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='44' cy='44' r='20' fill='#8b6b4a'/>
  <!-- facial disc -->
  <circle cx='44' cy='46' r='15' fill='#e8c9a0'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='37' cy='45' r='6' fill='#fff7d6'/>
  <circle cx='51' cy='45' r='6' fill='#fff7d6'/>
  <circle cx='37' cy='45' r='3' fill='#2b2b3a'/>
  <circle cx='51' cy='45' r='3' fill='#2b2b3a'/>
  <circle cx='36' cy='44' r='1.2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='44' r='1.2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- beak -->
  <polygon points='44,50 40,56 48,56' fill='#ffb347'/>
  <!-- feet -->
  <path d='M36 94 l-4 0 M36 94 l0 -4 M36 94 l4 0' stroke='#ffb347' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M52 94 l-4 0 M52 94 l0 -4 M52 94 l4 0' stroke='#ffb347' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
